texts.title: Cityline Bike Hire — tickets and prices

paragraphs.text: Cityline bikes can be hired from any of our 25 docking stations using the Cityline app. A single ride costs £1.50 for the first 30 minutes and £1 for every additional 30 minutes.

If you ride often, a day pass may save you money. It costs £6 and includes unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each within 24 hours. For regular users, a monthly membership costs £15 and includes unlimited rides of up to 60 minutes each.

Electric bikes are available at 10 of the stations. They cost an extra 20p per minute on all tickets. Bikes must be returned to a docking station; a £50 charge applies if a bike is left anywhere else.

To start a ride, scan the code on the handlebars with the app and wait for the lock to open. If a bike is damaged, please report it in the app before you set off, so that you are not charged for the damage.

document.title: Cityline Bike Hire — tickets and prices

items.quote: A single ride costs £1.50 for the first 30 minutes

explanation.en: “£1.50 for the first 30 minutes” → 30. 45 and 60 are the passes in other rows.
explanation.kk: «£1.50 for the first 30 minutes» → 30. 45 пен 60 — басқа жолдардағы абонемент бойынша сапарлар.
explanation.ru: «£1.50 for the first 30 minutes» → 30. 45 и 60 — поездки по абонементам в других строках.

items.quote: It costs £6 and includes unlimited rides of up to 45 minutes each within 24 hours

explanation.en: “It costs £6” → £6 (the sign is optional). “24 hours” is how long it lasts, not the price.
explanation.kk: «It costs £6» → £6 (белгісіз де болады). «24 hours» — бағасы емес, әрекет ету мерзімі.
explanation.ru: «It costs £6» → £6 (можно без знака). «24 hours» — срок действия, а не цена.

explanation.en: “a monthly membership costs £15” → £15. £50 in paragraph 3 is a penalty, not a membership.
explanation.kk: «a monthly membership costs £15» → £15. 3-абзацтағы £50 — айыппұл, абонемент емес.
explanation.ru: «a monthly membership costs £15» → £15. £50 в абзаце 3 — штраф, а не абонемент.

items.quote: includes unlimited rides of up to 60 minutes each
items.prompt: Monthly membership: each ride up to 4 ____ minutes

explanation.en: “unlimited rides of up to 60 minutes each” → 60. 45 belongs to the day pass, one row above.
explanation.kk: «unlimited rides of up to 60 minutes each» → 60. 45 — бір күндік абонемент, бір жол жоғары.
explanation.ru: «unlimited rides of up to 60 minutes each» → 60. 45 — это дневной абонемент, строкой выше.

items.quote: They cost an extra 20p per minute on all tickets

explanation.en: “an extra 20p per minute” → 20p. “10 of the stations” is a number of stations, not a price.
explanation.kk: «an extra 20p per minute» → 20p. «10 of the stations» — баға емес, станциялар саны.
explanation.ru: «an extra 20p per minute» → 20p. «10 of the stations» — число станций, а не цена.
